integrity: All-parameter proof using exact forbidden-pair decomposition, crown factor join and integral Kunneth; 32 independent finite distance checks, 24 face enumerations, 90 signed trace checks; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Equal-length unit theta arms, finite graph vertices, penultimate integer radius; no other radii or continuum graph points. Bibliographic coverage is not exhaustive.
title: A diameter-minus-one Rips wedge theorem for equilateral theta graphs
